ifc.title: IFC4 export
ifc.intro: Exports the active variant as IFC4 (storeys, spaces, slabs), georeferenced in the project coordinate system.

archicad.title: Import into Archicad
archicad.merge: Existing project: File › Interoperability › IFC › Merge – levels become stories, spaces become zones.
archicad.hotlink: As an updatable reference: place the file as a Hotlink module and update it after each export; IDs stay stable.
archicad.origin: 0,0 in the file is the local project origin; its projected coordinates are in IfcMapConversion. On import choose “Survey Point” for georeferenced placement, otherwise “Project Origin”.
